players.product: Scale-up optical interconnect: LightSphere X GPU-supernode distributed optical circuit switch (dOCS) and OCS silicon-photonics PIC, Scale-up EPS (pluggable LPO moving to 3.2T / 6.4T NPO silicon-photonics PICs), CPO optical engines, 800G / 1.6T transceiver PICs

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (interim report): based on its business developments, commercialization plans and the estimates and assumptions disclosed in its prospectus, the company expects its revenue in 2027 to reach the revenue threshold of a Commercial Company under Chapter 18C of the Listing Rules and anticipates qualifying as a Commercial Company by 2027 (company expectation, subject to those assumptions). In optical computing, a long-term strategy, it plans to work with GPU vendors, server manufacturers and algorithm-framework developers on adapting optoelectronic computing at the application-software layer.
quarterly_data.figure: Commercial Company revenue threshold expected in 2027

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 financial detail (interim report): gross profit RMB52,523 thousand, up approximately RMB44.22 million (+532%); revenue included optical interconnect technology development services and others of RMB4,792 thousand and optical computing product sales of RMB18,478 thousand (RMB2,735 thousand a year earlier), the optical computing growth coming from continued sales of optical computing hardware (the PACE series and Gazelle) in the single-card sales model, which the company says carries a higher gross margin than the sale of optical computing clusters. Loss for the period RMB3,256.74 million, mainly a non-cash fair value change of RMB2,916.53 million on investors' preferred-rights instruments, which converted into shares at the April 28, 2026 listing. Total R&D expenditure RMB330,775 thousand, including IP license expenses of RMB15,230 thousand and design and development expenses of RMB65,809 thousand; other income RMB120.58 million (+128%), mainly government grants; net cash used in operating activities RMB187.61 million (RMB92.73 million); capital commitments RMB20.20 million; 249 employees.
quarterly_data.figure: Gross profit +532%; loss RMB3,256.74 million (non-cash fair value change RMB2,916.53 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Optical computing commercialization (H1 2026 interim report): the company signed strategic partnership agreements with leading domestic internet and artificial intelligence enterprises, financial institutions, scientific-research institutions and compute-infrastructure providers (not named) to explore low-latency inference, embodied AI, AI for science, financial intelligent interaction and commercial aerospace; 'PACE 2 LightCube' devices were first deployed internally in its office access-control system, used by hundreds of employees, and the next planned scenario is internal chip-design inference tasks; Gazelle evaluation hardware sales grew.
